item.title: Sale closed in Alameda: $2.3 million for a single-family home
item.description: A single-family home located in the 900 block of Fountain Street in Alameda changed owner on Dec. 22, 2025. The 2,576-square-foot house, built in 1973, was sold for $2,300,000, or $893 per square foot. This two-story house has four bedrooms and three bathrooms. Additionally, the home includes access to two parking spots. The property's lot measures 5,978 square feet.

item.title: San Jose Unified delays school closure vote amid community concerns
item.description: San Jose Unified announced its plan to close schools earlier this month as part of the district's "Schools of Tomorrow" initiative. Launched last fall, the plan attempts to address the loss of nearly 6,000 students -- a 20% decline in enrollment -- since 2017, by closing or consolidating up to 9 of the district's 27 elementary schools.
